transcript: Okay, so I think technology in these days nowadays is nothing less than a blessing. And technology is something which is bought as so many appliances, which is making our lives easier on every level I would say. Here I would like to talk about a device which I use regularly and bi -regularily I mean it's not daily, it is used on an hourly basis I would say. And that's Amazon Alexa. And what's special about device, about this device is that it's totally based on artificial intelligence. So there are very few buttons and there's no touchscreen because a lot of us are right now habitual of touching our phones and because of this corona virus we were not allowed to touch each other or we were very cautious and sanitizing our hands but this device even at that time there was no problem in using this because it is totally controlled by the voice and it as it is based on artificial intelligence you know you don't use your own intelligence and you just let it do it works. And the thing is, I first, earlier I used to have a clock next to my bed and it used to ring and wake me up, but when the battery was low, it would be a nightmare for me, I would say, because I was not able to get up on time and reach where I wanted to. But since this, I just tell Alexa, hey, Alexa, wake me up at 5 a .m. in the morning. And I don't have to do anything else. I just have to sit and relax. And at five AM, there is a very notorious alarm which is run so that I can wake up and you won't believe the other.
